title: Morpheus8 Recovery and Aftercare, Day by Day
h1: Morpheus8 recovery: what your skin looks like day by day
desc: Morpheus8 aftercare and recovery day by day: redness, grid marks, when to wear make-up, exercise and sun, and when results appear. From Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: After Morpheus8 the skin is red and warm like mild sunburn for 1 to 3 days, with faint grid marks that fade within a week. Most people wear make-up after 24 to 48 hours and return to the gym after 48 hours. Results begin at around 3 weeks and keep improving for 3 months.
body:
## The first 48 hours

- Use only a gentle cleanser and the soothing product we give you
- No make-up, acids, retinol or scrubs
- Avoid heat, sauna, steam and intense exercise
- Sleep on a clean pillowcase

## Days 3 to 7

Skin can feel dry and rough as it renews. Keep moisturising and do not pick flakes. Reintroduce your normal skincare gradually after a week, leaving retinol and acids until day 7 or later.

## Sun protection

Freshly treated skin burns and pigments easily. Use SPF 50 daily and stay out of direct sun for two weeks, which matters in Dubai's climate.

## When to call us

Contact the clinic if you notice increasing pain, swelling after day 3, pus or fever.
faq: Most people are presentable with make-up after 1 to 2 days.
When can I use retinol after Morpheus8?
Usually after 7 days, once the skin has settled.
How many sessions until I see results?
Many see a change after one; a course of 3 gives the best result for scars.
